Title: Dynamic RAG Platform
TechStack: Python, Streamlit, LangChain, RAG, Tavily, Groq
Description: Developed a dynamic RAG platform using Streamlit, LangChain, RAG, Tavily, and Groq. Implemented a vector-first approach with intelligent grading and auto-fallback to web search. Created a premium UI with dark theme and glassmorphism design. Added a dashboard for analytics and settings for LLM providers.

Title: PPE Detection using YOLOv8
Description: Designed a computer vision pipeline using YOLOv8 and OpenCV by training two separate models for person and PPE detection. Implemented a sequential approach where detected persons were cropped and passed to the PPE model. Improved detection accuracy by 15%.

Title: Chennai Weather Forecast using Time Series
Description: Conducted time series analysis on Chennai weather forecast data by performing preprocessing EDA and applying SARIMAX and LSTM models. Achieved a forecasting accuracy improvement of 18% over baseline models enabling more reliable weather trend predictions.

Title: Reactive_AI Research Agent
Description: An autonomous research agent built with LangGraph, LangChain, and Groq. This agent accepts a research topic, performs deep web research using Tavily, scrapes relevant content, and generates comprehensive reports in multiple formats (PDF, PPTX, DOCX, Markdown).
